# Support

- **Free modules:** report bugs on the module's own GitHub issues page, or ask in the [Bakshi's Bazaar Discord](https://discord.gg/tcdYk54fxC).
- **Premium modules:** help and bug reports go through the [Bakshi's Bazaar Discord](https://discord.gg/tcdYk54fxC).

See the [Support page](https://gnollstack.github.io/bakshis-bazaar-archives/support.html) for links and what to include in a report.
